mapper.select: select c.id, c.template_id, c.customer_id, k.name as customer_name, c.create_by, c.create_time from price_template_customer c left join t_customer k on k.id = c.customer_id where c.template_id = #{templateId} order by c.id asc

select c.id, c.template_id, c.customer_id, k.name as customer_name, c.create_by, c.create_time from price_template_customer c left join t_customer k on k.id = c.customer_id where c.customer_id = #{customerId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into price_template_customer (template_id, customer_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{templateId}, #{customerId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from price_template_customer where template_id = #{templateId} and customer_id = #{customerId}
